summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_015 contract: it composes atomic OutputBlock records from governed inference records, emits matching BlockTrace records and CompositionRecord audit entries, preserves contract/version/lineage metadata, and rejects invalid inputs without partial block emission.

findings: The code accepts the declared inputs inference_records, phase_contracts and version_records, validates required inference metadata, resolves phase contract and version references, and emits the declared outputs output_blocks, block_traces and composition_log.
The implementation maps inference categories through the supplied phase contract block_type_map and filters visible_payload to contract-allowed visible fields only.
Invalid or unsupported records are represented as structured rejections in CompositionRecord.rejected_refs instead of producing partial OutputBlock or BlockTrace records.
OutputBlock, BlockTrace and CompositionRecord include motor_id, produced_by_motor, produced_at, version_id, version_hash, source_ref and parent_id fields as required by the technical schema.
BlockTrace.segment_refs cover addressable visible_payload paths with source_inference_id, version_ref, lineage_ref and phase_contract_ref.
Deterministic identifiers are derived from canonical sorted material and remained stable across a repeated run with identical input, contract version and rule version.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Read-only executable smoke checks covered the documented happy path, deterministic rebuild identity stability, and malformed input rejection. The checks are sufficient for this conformance review because Gate 6 requires a report verdict and the implementation-stage artifacts already satisfy the earlier gate conditions.
test_results.notes: Executed the implementation through the package import path with .venv/bin/python3. No standalone test runner artifact was added during this conformance stage; the checks were derived from test_spec.md and left implementation files unchanged.
